verdict.rationale: Rev AI documents an Asynchronous Speech-to-Text API that takes submitted transcription jobs (with job parameters such as source_config), so the job-creation half of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows a status-polling endpoint or named job states; the only completion signal described is webhooks, which is a separate story. Missing for 10: documented job status endpoint, enumerated job states (e.g. in_progress/transcribed/failed), polling guidance, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I create a transcription job and poll its status through documented job states until the result is ready

citations.quote: This tutorial uses the Asynchronous Speech to Text API to produce a transcript of an audio file submitted by you.
File uploads via the Rev AI dashboard or using the source_config job parameter have a file size limit of 5 TB.
